player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Player {player_id} long gem HighSociety (version bilong 2 pleya).
Flow bilong gem:  Ten prestige cards i go long auction wan afta nating.
Bidding:    Long ek auction, yu pilim wanpela mani kard 1-11 na yu sho.
            • Haida bid winim prestige kard na kisim wei mani kard.
            • Loa bid save mani kard bilong en.
            • Tie -> tupela bids i go bek na wanpela prestige kard em i go long auction gen.
Scoring:    Bihaenim ol ten auctions, yu add **mani i stap + poits bilong prestige**.
            Haida *net-worth* win (tie isi -> drai).

**Action syntax**  →  bidim wanpela kard olsem '[7]' o '[11]'.

board.money_cards: Ol mani yu holim yet long ol kat bilong yu: {money}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Em i mas gat wanpela [X] mani kat.
invalid_move.card_not_held: Yu no gat dispela mani long karet.

message.auction_result: P0 bid {bid0}, P1 bid {bid1}. Player {winner} wins prestige {prize} (total {total}).

outcome.draw: Tupela i gat wankain mani {nw0}  stret.
